# Lindberg Safaris

> Premium Safari Tours, Bespoke Adventures, and Luxury Travel in East Africa.

Lindberg Safaris is a premier luxury safari operator and travel management company based in Nairobi, Kenya. We specialize in handcrafted, tailor-made safari itineraries, wildlife expeditions, luxury tented camps, hotel bookings, flight ticketing, and complete destination management across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, and Rwanda.

## Key Services
- **Safari Tours & Packages**: Custom private game drives, Great Migration specials in Masai Mara & Serengeti, Amboseli elephant encounters, and family holidays.
- **Accommodation & Luxury Stays**: Safari lodges, boutique hotels, luxury tented camps, coastal beach resorts, and private villas.
- **Flight & Transport Logistics**: Domestic bush flights, international air ticketing, 4x4 custom Land Cruiser safari vehicles, airport transfers, and chauffeur drive.
- **Visa Application Support**: Complete documentation guidance for tourist visas, e-visas, and transit permits.
- **Customized Itineraries**: Honeymoon safaris, cultural expeditions, photography tours, and corporate retreats.

## Core Destinations
- **Kenya**: Masai Mara National Reserve, Amboseli National Park, Lake Nakuru, Tsavo East & West, Samburu, Ol Pejeta, Diani Beach, Lamu Island, Mount Kenya.
- **Tanzania**: Serengeti National Park, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Zanzibar Island.
- **Uganda & Rwanda**: Bwindi Impenetrable Forest & Volcanoes National Park (Gorilla Trekking).
